# **The UFO Incident in Varginha, Minas Gerais, Brazil**

In the small town of Varginha, located in the interior of Minas Gerais, Brazil, a peculiar incident occurred on January 20, 1996, which sparked widespread speculation and became the subject of a rumor that still resonates today. The story involves the alleged capture of two Extraterrestrials (ETs) and has been a topic of fascination and debate among the Brazilian population.
